hints.title: Consecutive Value Gap Detection
hints.text: Compare each adjacent pair of elements in the sorted array, including bounds lower and upper, checking if the gap between them is strictly greater than one.

hints.title: Tracking Previous Frontier Position
hints.text: Initialize previous marker to lower minus one. For each value including upper plus one as the virtual terminal value, emit an interval if current minus previous exceeds one.

hints.title: Single Pass Range Formulation
hints.text: Set prev = lower - 1. For index i from 0 to n inclusive, let curr be nums[i] if i < n else upper + 1. If curr - prev >= 2, append [prev + 1, curr - 1] to results. Update prev to curr.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of elements in nums
complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving linear O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space beyond the output list.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Iterating through all integers between lower and upper takes O(upper - lower) time, which is prohibitive for wide ranges.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Iterating only over sorted array elements avoids scanning unrepresented numbers.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle empty input arrays, 64-bit integer overflows when lower or upper lie near integer boundaries, and single-element gaps.
